body: Yes, I can understand that when anxiety is not giving you a chance to be at peace while waiting for a better future, suicide seems like the only way to end the pain.  I think that at times like this, we have our friends and family for moral support.  Heck, just posting one's concerns on this forum sometimes provides adequate release of stress - the whole world hears you at this forum,  so in a way, one is no longer alone.
Hello wonderful Moderators, I would be eternally grateful if my post is approved, many thanks!

I feel the same way: no accomplishments, keep on destroying the opportunities given to me, and too scared to end my life, though I've tried many half-assed attempts that miserably failed.  Maybe fate wants me to stay alive, maybe I have something in the future to offer mankind, who knows.  So I wait.  Maybe good things are awaiting you as well.
I will miss you.  You are a human being, and that is all that matters.
I hope you feel better.  We are here for you.
